plain: Equation (5). ∑i aiKL(q∥pi) − ∑j βjEq[Rj ] = A Eq[log q] − Eq[∑i ai log pi + ∑j βjRj], and the bracket equals A log q⋆ + A log Z. Under the forward KL the same weights give ∑i aiKL(pi∥q) = −A Ep¯[log q]+const with p¯ = ∑i(ai/A)pi, whose minimiser is the mixture: the product is a consequence of the direction of the KL that DMD can estimate, not of the weights.
after: Equation (5). $\sum_i a_i\operatorname{KL}(q\|p_i) - \sum_j\beta_j\mathbb{E}_q[\mathcal{R}_j] = A\mathbb{E}_q[\log q] - \mathbb{E}_q\left[\sum_i a_i\log p_i + \sum_j\beta_j\mathcal{R}_j\right]$, and the bracket equals $A\log q^\star + A\log Z$. Under the forward KL the same weights give $\sum_i a_i\operatorname{KL}(p_i\|q) = -A\mathbb{E}_{\bar{p}}[\log q]+\mathrm{const}$ with $\bar{p} = \sum_i(a_i/A)p_i$, whose minimiser is the mixture: the product is a consequence of the direction of the KL that DMD can estimate, not of the weights.
